Ben / Marissa — thanks for the heads-up. I pulled together the items we can share externally and proposed wording for the IR timeline below. Files are attached and I've staged a secure Drive folder (link below) with the redacted SOC 2 summary. Please review before we send to Aurora.

Proposed public-facing IR timeline (summary):
- Detection (T0): Our monitoring and alerting surface potential incidents immediately.
- Triage & Assessment (T0 + 0–24 hours): Security team performs initial impact assessment (scope, affected workloads, PHI exposure).
- Initial Customer Notification (T0 + 24–72 hours): We notify impacted customers within 24–72 hours of confirmed impact. Standard offering: 48-hour initial notification. We can accelerate to 24 hours for contractually committed SLAs; we do not guarantee advance notice for suspected incidents until confirmed.
- Remediation & Mitigation (T0 + variable): Technical remediation steps deployed; we provide ongoing updates at agreed cadence.
- Closure & Root Cause (T0 + ~30 days): Final report and lessons learned typically provided within 30 days; PII/PHI-specific forensic artifacts may take longer.

Shareable artifacts attached:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (redacted one-page summary)
- bcp-dr-playbook-excerpt.pdf (2-page excerpt suitable for procurement)
- incident-notification-template.docx (customer-facing notification template)

Staging link (internal -> will share secure view to Aurora): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_redwood/aurora-security-pack

Notes / actions:
- We should request an NDA if Aurora requires full SOC 2 report. Otherwise share the redacted one-pager.
- Recommend including our standard BAA clause language if Aurora requires HIPAA coverage — legal should be looped if they require modifications.
- Marissa: please review the redactions in the SOC 2 summary (I removed hostnames, internal ticket IDs). Ben: confirm you'd like me to send the staged folder link + attachments to Hannah with a brief covering email.

ETA: I can send to Aurora once you confirm redaction/BAA approach — aiming to send by 11:15am CT today.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
